import sys
import math

def multiply(a, b, mod):
    lenA, lenB = len(a), len(b)
    need = lenA + lenB - 1
    size = 1
    while size < need:
        size <<= 1

    ar = [0.0] * size
    ai = [0.0] * size
    br = [0.0] * size
    bi = [0.0] * size

    for i in range(lenA):
        val = ((a[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        ar[i] = val & 0x7fff
        ai[i] = val >> 15
    for i in range(lenB):
        val = ((b[i] % mod) + mod) % mod
        br[i] = val & 0x7fff
        bi[i] = val >> 15

    transform(ar, ai, False)
    transform(br, bi, False)

    cr = [0.0] * size
    ci = [0.0] * size
    dr = [0.0] * size
    di = [0.0] * size

    factor = 0.25 / size
    for i in range(size):
        j = (size - i) & (size - 1)

        a1r = (ar[i] + ar[j]) * 0.5
        a1i = (ai[i] - ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2r = (ai[i] + ai[j]) * 0.5
        a2i = (ar[j] - ar[i]) * 0.5

        b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * 0.5
        b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * 0.5
        b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * 0.5

        cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
        ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i
        dr[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
        di[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

    transform(cr, ci, True)
    transform(dr, di, True)

    result = [0] * need
    for i in range(need):
        p1 = round(cr[i])
        p2 = round(dr[i])
        p3 = round(ci[i])
        result[i] = int((p1 + ((p2 % mod) << 15) + ((p3 % mod) << 30)) % mod)
    return result

def transform(re, im, inverse):
    n = len(re)
    bits = 32 - (n).bit_length() + 1 if n > 0 else 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        j = int(bin(i)[2:].zfill(bits)[::-1], 2)
        if i < j:
            re[i], re[j] = re[j], re[i]
            im[i], im[j] = im[j], im[i]

    len_val = 2
    while len_val <= n:
        half = len_val >> 1
        cosTable = [0.0] * half
        sinTable = [0.0] * half
        angle = 2 * math.pi / len_val * (-1 if inverse else 1)
        for i in range(half):
            cosTable[i] = math.cos(i * angle)
            sinTable[i] = math.sin(i * angle)

        for i in range(0, n, len_val):
            for j in range(half):
                cr = cosTable[j]
                ci = sinTable[j]
                ur = re[i + j]
                ui = im[i + j]
                vr = re[i + j + half] * cr - im[i + j + half] * ci
                vi = re[i + j + half] * ci + im[i + j + half] * cr

                re[i + j] = ur + vr
                im[i + j] = ui + vi
                re[i + j + half] = ur - vr
                im[i + j + half] = ui - vi

        len_val <<= 1

    if inverse:
        for i in range(n):
            re[i] /= n
            im[i] /= n

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, input_stream):
        self.input = input_stream
        self.buffer = bytearray(1024)
        self.index = 0
        self.total = 0

    def get(self):
        if self.total == -1:
            raise RuntimeError()
        if self.index >= self.total:
            self.index = 0
            try:
                self.total = self.input.readinto(self.buffer)
            except:
                raise RuntimeError()
            if self.total <= 0:
                return -1
        result = self.buffer[self.index]
        self.index += 1
        return result

    def nextInt(self):
        c = self.get()
        while c <= ord(' '):
            if c == -1:
                raise RuntimeError()
        sign = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sign = -1
            c = self.get()
        num = 0
        while c > ord(' '):
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                raise RuntimeError()
            num = num * 10 + c - ord('0')
            c = self.get()
        return num * sign

def main():
    in_reader = InputReader(sys.stdin.buffer)
    out = sys.stdout

    MOD = 998244353
    n = in_reader.nextInt()
    k = in_reader.nextInt()
    poly = [0] * 10
    for _ in range(k):
        poly[in_reader.nextInt()] = 1

    res = [1]
    exp = n // 2
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = multiply(res, poly, MOD)
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD)
        exp >>= 1

    total_sum = 0
    for val in res:
        total_sum = (total_sum + val * val) % MOD
    out.write(str(total_sum).encode())
    out.write(b'\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
